card.name: Event and meeting words in news
card.fires_on: Scattered general-web words tied to gatherings or events, such as guest(s) for dinner, a conference, a forum, or a teleconference. No single word type fits all cases.

modes.label: Gathering words
modes.description: Words about dinners, guests, conferences or forums being held or attended.
modes.example: The announcement comes ahead of a major<< conference>> on mercury to be held in Geneva next

modes.label: Odd boundary spots
modes.description: Spaces, brackets or name starts in headers and bios, with no clear link to meaning.
modes.example: Monday, September 24, 2012 - 18:30 in Astronomy & Space<< >>NASA's rover Curiosity touched a Martian

card.writes: It weakly pushes away event-hosting words like exhibit, committee and session, and toward monthly-timing words.
card.plain: It is a weak, mixed signal that shows up around event and meeting words in general news text.
